subject: general
question: Ina certain code language, ‘he is good boy’ is written as ‘no po ko lo’, ‘good for health’ is written as ‘po ro fo’ and ‘health is good’ is written as ‘fo ko po’. Which code stands for ‘is’ in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e005b6eff3f8d37f7c9b0ac2bb80237bac4a1aca521b08c1592f98bcab32acf0.png] 

The code for ‘good’ is ’po’

The code for ‘health’ is ‘fo’

And the code for ‘is’ is ‘ko’

Hence, ‘ko’ is the correct answer.
